svg.title: SparkRing on two to eight DGX Sparks
svg.desc: Node A, the DGX Spark on your network, runs sparkring and serves the OpenAI-compatible API of a model group that starts at it and the ring dashboard. Sparks are joined only by direct ConnectX-7 cables, as a pair (p0 to p0), a line of three to eight or a ring of three to eight (each p0 to the next Spark's p1). The example is a ring of eight serving two four-Spark models, on positions 0-3 and 4-7. Traffic between Sparks that share no cable crosses the Sparks between them, whose ConnectX-7 forwards it in hardware; a SIRCL lane crosses at most three such relays.
